_why: Tail family for ISCO minor group 932 (Manufacturing Labour). Bound at MINOR level (specificity 30) rather than per unit group: the 932x units are narrow industrial specialisations whose workers would get near-identical questions, and 158 near-duplicate packs would be padding that LOOKS like coverage. A unit-level family always wins over this one — that is what the six specificity levels are for.

_deprecated: KEPT ON DISK, NOT DELETED. A session can pin (pack_id, version) and `loadPinned` loads that exact version whatever its status — and the TTS reply-closure manifest is built from whatever this corpus holds, so a version that stops existing serves a mid-interview worker strings that were never rendered. On the voice form that is silence, at a question they cannot read. Retiring this line from _published-versions.jsonl is a separate, reviewable claim that no live session pins it any more.
